question: For each winning player (winner identifier) and playing hand, taking each match joined to the player record whose player identifier equals the winner identifier (matches with no player record are dropped), compute the average winner ranking points and the average of (loser height − winner height), ignoring missing values in both (missing if none). Then rank these rows within each playing hand by that average height difference, descending with missing last, tied rows sharing a rank and the next rank skipping. Return winner identifier, playing hand, average winner ranking points, average height difference, and the rank, keeping only rows whose rank is at most 3.

Here A is loser height (`matches.loser_ht`); B is winner height (`matches.winner_ht`).
Step 2. Start from the rows of step 1; for each kept record, return (1) column (1) of step 1; (2) column (2) of step 1; (3) column (3) of step 1; (4) column (4) of step 1; (5) the rank of the row among the result rows that share the same value of column (2) of step 1 by column (4) of step 1 descending (missing last) (tied rows share a rank; the next rank skips).
